class.name: NNBTRunNQSQuery
class.brief_description: Runs a Node Query System query asynchronously.
class.description: Returns [constant NNBTNodes.RUNNING] until its query completes, then [constant NNBTNodes.SUCCESS], including when no results match. Returns [constant NNBTNodes.FAILURE] if the search space is missing, posting is rejected, or its query is cancelled or replaced. Resetting, reassigning, or removing the leaf stops only the query registration it posted. Queries posted by another caller are left untouched. A reset does not start a new query until the leaf is ticked again.

members.member: A node reference to a NQS Search Space node. (Changed from v1.4 node path).
The number of results the search should return. Overrides the setting on the search space.
